title: Privacy
description: What WattPrint keeps, what it sends outside, and how to delete it.
entry: See what is kept, what is sent outside, and delete data.

kept.title: What is kept
kept.description: Your home's electricity figures, from the finest to the coarsest.
kept.erased: Older figures were deleted up to {date}. If you chose to delete all, what had been recorded on that day went too.

outside.title: Sent outside
outside.description: Turn each service on or off.

email.name: Email
email.what: Your email address, alerts and the weekly summary. Alerts also have to be switched on in Alerts (off by default), the weekly summary in Settings.
email.where: A mail server delivers it to your inbox. WattPrint has not confirmed where that server is.

outside.ownerOnly: Only the home owner can change it.

log.title: Sent outside in the last 30 days
log.description: Only the kinds of data are recorded, never the content.
log.empty: Nothing sent in the last 30 days

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: What is deleted cannot be got back.
delete.noUndo: What is deleted cannot be got back.
delete.failed: Not deleted. Try again in a few minutes.

history.title: The home's electricity history
history.hint: Delete figures before a date, or all of them.
history.readings: Meter readings, per-device figures, alerts, forecasts and suggestions in that time are deleted.
history.bills: Bills of cycles wholly in that time are deleted. A cycle cut in two shows as incomplete.
history.stays: The device list and device recognition stay.
history.sent: Copies already sent to outside services cannot be deleted from here; each keeps them by its own rules.
history.cannot: Only the home owner can delete it. Demo homes cannot be deleted.
history.plans: Savings plans stay, but lose the figures of the deleted days.
history.dateInvalid: That date cannot be read. Enter day/month/year, no later than today.

chats.title: My chats
chats.hint: All your conversations with Wappi in this home.
chats.question: Delete every conversation?
chats.loses: All questions, answers and read-aloud audio are deleted.
chats.sent: What was already sent to outside services cannot be recalled.

account.title: My account
account.hint: Delete your account and your data.
account.question: Delete the account?
account.loses: Your profile, chats, savings plans, the alerts you set and your sign-in are deleted.
account.home: If you are the only one in the home, the home and all its electricity figures are deleted too.
account.sent: What was already sent to outside services cannot be recalled.

ai.title: How AI uses your data
ai.devices: Telling devices apart from the main meter runs on WattPrint's servers, with models learned from public datasets, not from your home's data.
ai.wappi: Wappi sends your question and the figures needed to answer it to an outside AI service; a phone number, email or card number you type is masked first.

refused.demo: A demo home cannot be deleted or changed.
refused.owner: Only the home owner can do this.
refused.other: That did not work. Try again in a few minutes.

members.title: Who can see
members.description: The people in the home and how finely they see it.
members.codeHint: Shown only once. For one person, for 7 days. They sign in, then enter it.
members.removeLoses: Removing someone deletes their chats, alerts and plans in this home.
members.leaveLoses: Your chats, alerts and plans in this home will be deleted.
members.visitor: You are viewing a demo home. With an invite code you can join your family's home.
